name: Mephistopheles
source:
A demon who wants to form a contract with Georik.

"...is a dark scary soul-stealing demon who follows Georik around like a lovesick puppy. A puppy with horns and talons and bat wings. He wears lipstick, and not in a manly way."

[Based on [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20061018090801/http://community.hirameki-int.com/modules/charpoll5/index.php?id=1]Hirameki's Official Site[/url] (Website is via webarchive)]
